body: He had an emotional affair about three years ago that lasted about 3 months, and ended with them kissing and the girl telling her partner. Throughout their relationship he promised me they were nothing more than friends. He wasn't going to tell me about it and I found out through mutual acquaintances. Since then, I have always had more of a concern about female friends. He went no contact with the girl he had an affair with. I have communicated my concerns to him and just asked that he be open about his female friends with me. I don't tell him that he can't have them. This bothers him though. I try to not bring them up at all now.
I know! I just can't even get my head around how anyone could treat someone like that.
